brave.title: Brave Search API
brave.description: Optional provider for live web results and suggestions inside Volt.
brave.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Brave Search API key
brave.storageNotice: Stored in the operating system credential vault. The key is never written to your settings file.

clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.infoText: Clipboard History stores your recent clipboard entries for quick access. Use
clipboard.infoTextSuffix: followed by your search term to find past clipboard items.

applications.title: Applications
applications.infoText: Volt automatically scans for installed applications on your system. Applications are refreshed each time Volt starts.
applications.scanAppsDesc: Manually trigger a scan for installed applications

shell.title: Shell Commands
shell.infoText: Execute shell commands directly from Volt with the
shell.infoTextSuffix: prefix. Output streams in real-time with ANSI color support.
shell.enabledDesc: Allow running commands with the > prefix

shell.historySizeDesc: Maximum number of commands to remember
shell.clearHistoryDesc: Remove all saved shell command history

snippetExpansion.infoText: In-app snippets are triggered by typing the

snippetExpansion.enabledDesc: Expand snippet triggers anywhere on Windows, not just in Volt
